en_title: Sony Issues New PS5 Firmware Update as Jailbreak Race Heats Up Ahead of GTA 6 Release
cn_title: PS5破解竞赛升温，索尼更新固件
subtitle: 打不完的地鼠
opus_summary: 索尼发布PS5的14.20固件，官方说明仅提及部分界面的改进，未提及安全更新。破解社区仍在尝试攻破新固件，外界担忧《GTA6》发售后可能遭遇盗版。

paragraphs.en: Sony has issued a new PlayStation 5 firmware update amid the homebrew community's ongoing effort to jailbreak the console.
paragraphs.cn: 自制软件社区仍在持续尝试破解PS5，索尼则发布了新的PS5固件更新。

paragraphs.en: PS5 system software update 26.07-14.20.00 is available now and weighs in at 1.2 GB. While Sony’s official patch notes suggest its only function is to improve “the messages and usability on some screens,” some believe it may perform other functions under the hood.
paragraphs.cn: PS5系统软件更新26.07-14.20.00现已推出，大小为1.2GB。索尼的官方更新说明只提到改善「部分界面的提示信息和易用性」，但有人认为，这次更新可能还在底层做了其他改动。

paragraphs.en: The PlayStation homebrew scene hit the headlines in recent weeks for releasing PS5 jailbreaks for prior firmwares. For example, late last month, a jailbreak that supported all PS5 consoles running firmware 7.00-13.60 sent shockwaves through the homebrew community. At the time, it meant that all PS5s, including the PS5 Pro, that hadn't been updated within the previous week, were compatible with the jailbreak.
paragraphs.cn: 最近几周，PlayStation自制软件社区因发布针对旧版固件的PS5破解而登上新闻。例如，上个月下旬，一款支持所有运行7.00至13.60固件的PS5主机的破解工具，在自制软件社区引起了轰动。当时，只要在此前一周内没有更新过系统，所有PS5主机，包括PS5 Pro，都可以使用这款破解工具。

paragraphs.en: This is of huge significance for Sony and the security of the PS5, as people with a jailbroken PS5 can modify their console, potentially opening the door to video game piracy. However, it was found that some PS5 games subsequently required the latest 14.00 firmware in order to download updates, sparking a renewed effort to release a new jailbreak for the updated system software.
paragraphs.cn: 这对索尼和PS5的安全至关重要，因为用户可以修改破解后的PS5主机，从而可能为盗版游戏打开大门。不过，人们随后发现，部分PS5游戏需要最新的14.00固件才能下载更新，这又促使破解社区尝试为更新后的系统软件推出新的破解工具。

paragraphs.en: So, there is a game of Whac-A-Mole at play where the homebrew scene is working to release a new jailbreak for the latest PS5 firmware, then do it all over again when Sony releases a new firmware update designed to beef up security. It’s worth pointing out that Sony makes no mention of security in today’s patch notes.
paragraphs.cn: 于是，双方陷入了一场打地鼠式的较量：自制软件社区努力为最新的PS5固件推出破解，等索尼发布旨在加强安全性的新固件后，社区又得从头再来。值得指出的是，索尼在今天的更新说明中并未提及安全性。

paragraphs.en: This in turn has sparked concern that if a PS5 jailbreak is made available for the firmware that is required by GTA 6, which comes out in less than a month, then it may be possible for Rockstar’s game to be pirated on PS5 and maybe even made available on PC.
paragraphs.cn: 这也引发了担忧：《GTA6》距离发售已不足一个月，如果破解社区攻破了运行该作所需的PS5固件，那么Rockstar的这款游戏就可能在PS5上遭遇盗版，甚至可能被搬到PC上。

paragraphs.en: One prominent member of the PlayStation homebrew community recently showed evidence of a jailbreak for the 14.10 firmware, but follow up comments suggest that dumping game executables isn't possible. There is no evidence to suggest that today’s 14.20 update is a response to that. However, some believe GTA 6 will require at least 14.20 to run, now it’s out in the wild. Sony may even release a further security update before November 19.
paragraphs.cn: PlayStation自制软件社区的一位知名成员最近展示了14.10固件已被破解的证据，但后续评论表明，目前还无法提取游戏的可执行文件。没有证据表明，今天的14.20更新是针对这次破解推出的。不过，如今14.20固件已经发布，有人认为《GTA6》至少需要这一版本才能运行。索尼甚至可能在11月19日之前再推出一次安全更新。

paragraphs.en: The question for Sony is whether it can do enough to eventually win this game of Whac-A-Mole with the homebrew scene. This is something of an existential crisis for Sony, which publishers and developers rely upon for the security of their PlayStation releases. But with the emergence of powerful AI models, the stakes have risen significantly.
paragraphs.cn: 索尼面临的问题是，它能否采取足够的措施，最终赢下与自制软件社区之间的这场打地鼠较量。发行商和开发者依靠索尼保障其PlayStation游戏的安全，因此，这对索尼而言堪称一场关乎生存的危机。而随着强大AI模型的出现，这场较量的成败变得更加攸关重大。
